record.bible_text: And the LORD<WH03068> spake<WH01696><WTH8762> unto Moses<WH04872>, saying<WH0559><WTH8800>,

And thou shalt bring<WH07126><WTH8689> the Levites<WH03881> before<WH06440> the tabernacle<WH0168> of the congregation<WH04150>: and thou shalt gather<WH06950><WH00> the whole assembly<WH05712> of the children<WH01121> of Israel<WH03478> together<WH06950><WTH8689>:

And thou shalt bring<WH07126><WTH8689> the Levites<WH03881> before<WH06440> the LORD<WH03068>: and the children<WH01121> of Israel<WH03478> shall put<WH05564><WTH8804> their hands<WH03027> upon the Levites<WH03881>:

And the Levites<WH03881> shall lay<WH05564><WTH8799> their hands<WH03027> upon the heads<WH07218> of the bullocks<WH06499>: and thou shalt offer<WH06213><WTH8798> the one<WH0259> <FI>for<Fi> a sin offering<WH02403>, and the other<WH0259> <FI>for<Fi>  a burnt offering<WH05930>, unto the LORD<WH03068>, to make an atonement<WH03722><WTH8763> for the Levites<WH03881>.

And thou shalt set<WH05975><WTH8689> the Levites<WH03881> before<WH06440> Aaron<WH0175>, and before<WH06440> his sons<WH01121>, and offer<WH05130><WTH8689> them <FI>for<Fi> an offering<WH08573> unto the LORD<WH03068>.
Thus shalt thou separate<WH0914><WTH8689> the Levites<WH03881> from among<WH08432> the children<WH01121> of Israel<WH03478>: and the Levites<WH03881> shall be mine.

And after<WH0310> that shall the Levites<WH03881> go in<WH0935><WTH8799> to do the service<WH05647><WTH8800> of the tabernacle<WH0168> of the congregation<WH04150>: and thou shalt cleanse<WH02891><WTH8765> them, and offer<WH05130><WTH8689> them <FI> for<Fi> an offering<WH08573>.

For they <FI>are<Fi> wholly given<WH05414><WTH8803> unto me from among<WH08432> the children<WH01121> of Israel<WH03478>; instead of such as open<WH06363> every womb<WH07358>, <FI>even instead of<Fi>  the firstborn<WH01060> of all the children<WH01121> of Israel<WH03478>, have I taken<WH03947><WTH8804> them unto me.

For all the firstborn<WH01060> of the children<WH01121> of Israel<WH03478> <FI>are<Fi> mine, <FI>both<Fi> man<WH0120> and beast<WH0929>: on the day<WH03117> that I smote<WH05221><WTH8687> every firstborn<WH01060> in the land<WH0776> of Egypt<WH04714> I sanctified<WH06942><WTH8689> them for myself.
And I have taken<WH03947><WTH8799> the Levites<WH03881> for all the firstborn<WH01060> of the children<WH01121> of Israel<WH03478>.

And I have given<WH05414><WTH8799> the Levites<WH03881> <FI>as<Fi> a gift<WH05414><WTH8803> to Aaron<WH0175> and to his sons<WH01121> from among<WH08432> the children<WH01121> of Israel<WH03478>, to do<WH05647><WTH8800> the service<WH05656> of the children<WH01121> of Israel<WH03478> in the tabernacle<WH0168> of the congregation<WH04150>, and to make an atonement<WH03722><WTH8763> for the children<WH01121> of Israel<WH03478>: that there be no plague<WH05063> among the children<WH01121> of Israel<WH03478>, when the children<WH01121> of Israel<WH03478> come nigh<WH05066><WTH8800> unto the sanctuary<WH06944>. <RF>a gift: Heb. given<Rf>

And Moses<WH04872>, and Aaron<WH0175>, and all the congregation<WH05712> of the children<WH01121> of Israel<WH03478>, did<WH06213><WTH8799> to the Levites<WH03881> according unto all that the LORD<WH03068> commanded<WH06680><WTH8765> Moses<WH04872> concerning the Levites<WH03881>, so did<WH06213><WTH8804> the children<WH01121> of Israel<WH03478> unto them.

And the LORD<WH03068> spake<WH01696><WTH8762> unto Moses<WH04872>, saying<WH0559><WTH8800>,

This <FI>is it<Fi> that <FI>belongeth<Fi> unto the Levites<WH03881>: from twenty<WH06242> and five<WH02568> years<WH08141> old<WH01121> and upward<WH04605> they shall go in<WH0935><WTH8799> to wait<WH06633><WTH8800><WH06635> upon the service<WH05656> of the tabernacle<WH0168> of the congregation<WH04150>: <RF>to...: Heb. to war the warfare of, etc<Rf>
